product.description: Workstream™ by Monoprice™2‑Outlet Wall Tap Power StripTwo USB Type‑C® ports with 50W and 20W Power Delivery (PD) 3.0Add fast mobile and laptop charging capabilities to your standard wall outlet using this Workstream™ 2‑Outlet Wall Tap Power Strip from Monoprice™! This power strip plugs into a standard wall outlet and features two AC outlets and two USB‑C® charging ports. It has built‑in over current, over voltage, overload, short circuit, and over temperature circuits, ensuring that your connected devices are fully protected from dirty power.The two NEMA® 5‑15 power outlets are rated for 125 VAC, 15A/1875W, while the two USB‑C charging ports are rated for a total of 70W of Power Delivery (PD) 3.0, with 50W for the first port and 20W for the second port. The charging circuits feature Gallium Nitride (GaN) technology, which charges up to three times faster than chargers using traditional Silicon‑based circuits. The 50W on the first port is more than enough to charge and power laptop and notebook computers.The low profile design saves space and mounts directly over an existing 2‑socket AC wall outlet for a clean power distribution solution.
